|编号|  
|yahsan|postgis|结论|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|函数ST_Area入参值为E15、E-15，yashan结果与Postgis没有保持一致,  
|select ST_Area(ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-1.79769313486232E15 -4.94065645841247E-15, 4.94065645841247E-15 1.79769313486232E15, -4.94065645841247E-15 1.79769313486232E15, -1.79769313486232E15 -4.94065645841247E-15))',4327)) from dual;,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739694e8970c2af4f51f72e/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wuNYbTPqYZhxcmwAJxNP7fv5RF-fHStaShYj-G87sso)|select ST_Area('POLYGON((-1.79769313486232E15 -4.94065645841247E-15, 4.94065645841247E-15 1.79769313486232E15, -4.94065645841247E-15 1.79769313486232E15, -1.79769313486232E15 -4.94065645841247E-15))'::geography),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739694f8970c2af4f51f72f/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wuNYbTPqYZhxcmwAJxNP7fv5RF-fHStaShYj-G87sso)|保留差异，yashan数据库没啥问题，可能第三方库计算的时候 与 postgis的结果存在误差|
|2|ST_ClosestPoint geom坐标包含特殊值，极大值，和|--1.多点和多点，坐标有一组nan,返回结果不一样（点顺序）    
  select 2,152,st_astext(ST_ClosestPoint(st_geomfromtext('MULTIPOINT ZM(1.45678 1 6 10, 1 2 3 4)',4327),st_geomfromtext('MULTIPOINT(400 500,nan nan)',4327)),6) from dual;,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739694f8970c2af4f51f730/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wuNYbTPqYZhxcmwAJxNP7fv5RF-fHStaShYj-G87sso),--2. geom2坐标包含nan 返回POINT EMPTY //postgis返回nan nan    
  select 1,352,st_astext(ST_ClosestPoint(st_geomfromtext('LINESTRING(0.5 0.5, 1000 1000)',3857),st_geomfromtext('MULTILINESTRING Z ((90.7878 0 nan, 2000 0 nan), (100 200 nan, nan nan nan))',3857)),6),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739694fa1ad9a3311dc75a8/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wuNYbTPqYZhxcmwAJxNP7fv5RF-fHStaShYj-G87sso),--3.线和线 geom2坐标有极大极小值，结果返回不一样（点顺序）    
  select 7,251,st_astext(ST_ClosestPoint(st_geomfromtext('LINESTRING( 1 2 3 4, 2 2 4 5, 6 7 8 9,2.09887763434 3.9 4 10, 6 7 8 9)',3857),st_geomfromtext('LINESTRING(-1.79769313486232E308 -4.94065645841247E-324, 1 1, 1.79769313486232E308 4.94065645841247E-324)',3857)),6) from dual;    
  select 8,251,st_astext(ST_ClosestPoint(st_geomfromtext('LINESTRING Z(1 2 5 , 7 8 9 ,2.09887763434 3.9 4.98876665 , 89 90 91)',3857),st_geomfromtext('LINESTRING(-1.79769313486232E308 -4.94065645841247E-324, 1 1, 1.79769313486232E308 4.94065645841247E-324)',3857)),6) from dual;,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739694fa1ad9a3311dc75a9/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wuNYbTPqYZhxcmwAJxNP7fv5RF-fHStaShYj-G87sso),--4.多线和面 坐标有极大极小值    
  select 7,453,st_astext(ST_ClosestPoint(st_geomfromtext('MULTILINESTRING(( 100 100, 100 3000, 500 900, 800 10000),( -7000.757676 -6, -10.76676 -10), (-200.67676 -200 ,-500.97687 -500))',4479),st_geomfromtext('POLYGON M ((0 0 78 ,-1.79769313486232E308 -4.94065645841247E-324 78,10 10 78 ,0 10 78 ,0 0 78 ))',4479)),6) from dual;,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739694f8970c2af4f51f731/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wuNYbTPqYZhxcmwAJxNP7fv5RF-fHStaShYj-G87sso),--5.面和面 geom1坐标有极大极小值，返回geom2上的点；postgis返回geom1上的点    
  select 55,509, st_astext(ST_ClosestPoint(st_geomfromtext('POLYGON M ((0 0 78 ,-1.79769313486232E308 -4.94065645841247E-324 78,10 10 78 ,0 10 78 ,0 0 78 ))'),st_geomfromtext('POLYGON ((200000 0 ,300000 0,300000 10000000 ,200000 10000000,200000 0 ))')),6) from dual;,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739694f8970c2af4f51f732/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wuNYbTPqYZhxcmwAJxNP7fv5RF-fHStaShYj-G87sso)|  
|1.这个不一致是因为postgis不认为 (nan nan)是empty，这个保留不一致,2.这个实际上我们跟postgis返回的都是 point(nan nan)，但是postgis不认为这是empty，就直接输入了，我们的输出函数调用的是geos，geos认为这个empty，所以输出了empty的字样，保留不一致,3 4 5：都是精度问题，这些数值经过geos库处理之后走到我这里的变成了inf和-inf，然后计算过程中产生了nan，postgis应该拿到的不是inf，这种保留不一致就行了，实际不会用到那么大的数|
